description: Client-side service worker queue that intercepts offline booking and cart submissions, buffers them in IndexedDB, and synchronizes with the backend upon network reconnection.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/sw-custom.ts, app/utils/offlineQueue.ts, and app/plugins/pwa.client.ts.

description: Multi-step online appointment booking workflow allowing customers to select treatments, pick preferred therapists/beds, and schedule date/time slots.
Digital voucher wallet interface where customers view purchased treatment vouchers, monitor redemption statuses, and apply vouchers directly to new bookings.
Conversational AI booking assistant embedded in the storefront UI, guiding customers through treatment inquiries and automated appointment scheduling.
Listens to real-time WebSocket events upon session completion to trigger a non-intrusive feedback modal requesting rating and written customer review.
Searchable and category-filtered service catalog showcasing treatment descriptions, durations, pricing, dynamic promotional banners, and facility photos.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/pages/catalog.vue, app/pages/facilities.vue, and app/pages/treatments/index.vue.

description: Interactive historical log displaying completed, upcoming, and canceled customer appointments along with associated financial receipts.
Manages browser Web Push subscription registration and VAPID key exchange to receive push notifications for appointment updates and promotions.
